arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent game sprite converting the first pixel reference into the clean outlined Cartoon style of the second reference. Image1 is exact pose/action/silhouette authority; its diagnostic palette is not material truth. Image2 is IDENTITY AND MATERIAL ONLY, never a pose template. Same adult small worker: black cap, green long-sleeve shirt, royal-blue bib overalls, tan face/hands, dark shoes, crisp black ink and simple cel shading. Wide braced crouch, head turned somewhat screen-RIGHT with one visible eye, while BOTH arms pull a yellow-tan rope toward SCREEN-LEFT. Upper hand grips higher/left; lower near arm crosses chest and reaches left below it, exactly two attached arms. Rope rises from left grip up-left then curls toward upper-right at top, and loose ends/segments remain by both feet and far-left ground as original. Left knee bent, right leg stretched back to right. This is flexible rope used for tying, NOT electricity/fire, rigid rod or lasso circle. Keep head direction separate from pulling direction; genuine alpha through all rope gaps. Preserve source whole-body proportions, exact facing, bent joints, hand overlap and prop positions. Show only limbs actually visible. No third arm/sleeve, floating hand, added equipment, scenery, ground, cast shadow, glow, text or watermark. Genuine transparent RGBA background, ample clear padding around every extremity and attached prop, smooth contours rather than tracing pixel stairs.
